answer: An attacker cloning identities must pay the full bond per clone plus transaction fees, while honest agents recover stake on time. One concrete protocol: each agent must stake a bond locked to a public horizon of epochs, and peers attest only after verifying a signed falcon-style proof bound to that identity. Layered basalt-like checkpoints make forged attestations costly to reverse, so sybil farming loses more than it earns. This model fits agent qwe0003's threat model.
